inputs.description: Your own Unreal Tournament GOTY files (a folder or ZIP with Maps, Music, Sounds and Textures). You import them in UTP after installing; the build does not read them.

tools.name: jq
tools.note: Install it with Homebrew: brew install jq

tools.name: xcodebuild
tools.note: Install Xcode 26 or newer with its iOS platform, then select it in Xcode Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools; Command Line Tools alone are not enough.

tools.name: xcrun
tools.label: Xcode iPhoneOS SDK
tools.note: Install Xcode 26 or newer with its iOS platform, then select it in Xcode Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools; Command Line Tools alone are not enough.

publication.reason: Each copy is built on the player's own Mac from OldUnreal's free 469e release, so it stays personal. Unreal Tournament data is imported in the app.
